title: The TWAP Window
description: How much does it cost to shift a TWAP oracle? Drag pool TVL, TWAP duration, and price spike factor to see the round-trip manipulation cost alongside the 30-min TWAP shift — for both Uniswap v2 arithmetic and v3 geometric accumulators. Anchored to live on-chain pool data.
controls: Drag Pool TVL slider to change pool depth
Drag TWAP window slider (blocks) to see how duration affects spike cost
Drag price spike factor to see v2 vs v3 TWAP shift comparison
Toggle V2 / V3 to compare arithmetic vs geometric mean accumulator
